description: Design and analyze bounded agent task/trajectory evaluations and regression comparisons using authorized evidence.

provenance.author: LiNKskills Library

provenance.license: See per-source upstream license copies and manifest

routing.when_to_use: Design and analyze bounded agent task/trajectory evaluations and regression comparisons using authorized evidence.
when_not_to_use: A different task requires its own skill
exclusion_rules: Missing facts block the affected conclusion, not harmless drafting
ambiguity_rules: Read existing authorized evidence first; ask only material unanswered questions

required_inputs.name: task_inputs
required_inputs.description: evaluation decision and risk; candidate/baseline identities and comparable run settings; authorized immutable cases and provenance; task/trajectory/side-effect contracts; observed results and approved cost budget

expected_outputs.name: work_product
expected_outputs.description: versioned evaluation plan and dataset manifest; grader specification and observable assertions; per-case and per-dimension comparison with uncertainty; regression and blocked-environment report; owner decision, gaps and redacted monitoring plan

forbidden_actions: Unapproved payments, filings, postings, signatures, purchases, external announcements or production changes
Inventing source facts, approval or canon
verification_steps: Define the decision, target outcomes, task and trajectory contracts, forbidden side effects and risk before drafting cases. Select evidence by harm and reversibility; do not require one execution path where several valid paths satisfy the contract.

Freeze a versioned dataset with rights/consent, provenance, fixtures, expected side effects, contamination controls, retention, slices and limitations. Include representative happy, edge, adversarial and actual regression cases; fictional probes are labeled and do not represent production prevalence.

Choose the smallest adequate deterministic checks for observable structure, figures, permitted tools and final state; use environment/side-effect checks where schema cannot prove behavior. Route subjective judge design/calibration to agent-judge-calibration rather than invent a trustworthy scalar score.

Compare candidate and baseline under the same realistic context, tool, token and run conditions. Record repeats when variability changes the decision, observed trajectories, timeouts and environment/access failures; no model/paid execution without its existing authorization and budget.

Report paired per-case regressions, dimension and complexity-slice scores, denominators/missingness, effect and uncertainty alongside measured cost and P50/P95 latency. Failed environment cases remain visible separately; excluding them requires an explicit reason and must not inflate the behavioral pass claim.

Apply independent hard safety/privacy/authorization/side-effect gates that cannot be averaged away. Non-significance is not equivalence, repeated identical text is not effectiveness, and structural PASS covers only structure. Record the actual approval owner and insufficient-evidence outcome.

Use minimized redacted owner telemetry to monitor comparable production signals and turn verified failures into frozen regression cases after consent/transformation review. Re-evaluate relevant tests after model, prompt or tool changes; do not rewrite cases just to pass or impose a universal case count.
completion_criteria: Task output meets contract and task-specific acceptance criteria
Sources, uncertainty, exact completion scope and remaining decisions visible
Any authorized draft write read back
known_limitations: Structural qualification does not prove every behavior
Source originals are provenance; canonical method owns execution
Specialist content/draft access may be Sara-mediated

telemetry.retention_policy: retain opaque task/source ids and hashes only
